description: This file defines a controller class SaveLeaveTypeController for the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the rendering of leave type forms, either for editing or creating new leave types based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveLeaveTypeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the save operation for leave types, specifically preparing components for editing or creating leave types based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered, choosing between 'leave-type-edit' and 'leave-type-save' based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
